h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Thanjavur

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Thanjavur

c: Thanjavur is at the heart of the Cauvery delta, a temple town with colleges and schools that draw students from across Tamil Nadu. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Thanjavur for these campuses, and for municipal parks, temple trust grounds and residential layouts. We make every machine at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,160 km away, and send it to Tamil Nadu by road.

The delta is hot and humid, and the northeast monsoon between October and December brings heavy rain. Our galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts handle both. We plan an open gym around who will use it. For a college, that means strength work for students; for a public park, gentle machines for walkers. Installation is by our team or a dealer in south India.

richText.heading: Choosing machines for students and park walkers

wheel suits senior citizens who want to loosen their shoulders after a walk.

Thanjavur's flat delta ground holds water after heavy rain, so raise the pad and give it a slight slope. Place the gym under trees for shade in the hot months. items.q: Do you supply colleges and universities in Thanjavur?
items.a: Yes. We supply schools, colleges and universities across India. Share the size of the open space and the expected number of students for a layout drawing.

items.q: How should we prepare for the northeast monsoon?
items.a: Install the gym on a raised, sloped concrete pad with drains, and keep them clear through October to December. Galvanised frames and moulded parts resist rust in the rain.

items.q: Can a temple trust set up an open gym for devotees and residents?
items.a: Yes. A few gentle machines on a shaded part of the trust's ground suit older visitors well. We plan the layout around paths and gathering areas.
